description: This file defines the BigPipe placeholder strategy class for Drupal, implementing chunked HTML delivery with support for JavaScript and non-JavaScript placeholders, including methods for processing placeholders, generating placeholder IDs, and creating placeholder render arrays.

classes.name: BigPipeStrategy
classes.description: Implements a placeholder strategy for Drupal's BigPipe module, managing chunked HTML delivery with support for JavaScript and non-JavaScript placeholders, including placeholder processing, ID generation, and cache management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing session configuration, request stack, and route match objects.

methods.name: processPlaceholders
methods.description: Processes placeholders to determine if they should be transformed into BigPipe placeholders based on request method, route options, and session presence.

methods.name: doProcessPlaceholders
methods.description: Transforms each placeholder into a BigPipe placeholder, choosing between JavaScript and no-JS versions based on attribute safety and cookies.

methods.name: placeholderIsAttributeSafe
methods.description: Checks if a placeholder is safe for use within an HTML attribute.

methods.name: createBigPipeJsPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript-based BigPipe placeholder render array with associated metadata and attached libraries.

methods.name: createBigPipeNoJsPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a no-JS BigPipe placeholder render array, either as a span with data attribute or a safe attribute placeholder.

methods.name: generateBigPipePlaceholderId
methods.description: Generates a unique placeholder ID based on the placeholder's render array, using hashing for lazy builders or sanitizing the original placeholder.
